title: Remote-command return CoT on single command
target_operation: Return Information Caused by Remote Command
purpose: Exercise cause-of-transmission 11 on a complete, small C_SC_NA_1 APDU to cover remote-command return parsing without malformed framing.
expected_behavior: The endpoint should parse the frame successfully and expose CoT 11 handling for a valid single-command object.
constraints_preserved: CoT 11 is documented as Return Information Caused by Remote Command
APDU framing is complete and length-consistent
ASDU field ordering and widths are preserved
Exactly one IOA and one qualifier byte are encoded
issue_safety_notes: Remains a safe structural analogue with full bytes present and no reliance on malformed semantics.
